settings.title: A real pair of eyes
settings.text: The back print is a photograph, not an illustration — torn, layered, and screen-printed at true grain so the eyes stay recognizably someone's.

settings.title: Tap to remember
settings.text: A hidden NFC chip in the hem links to whatever you choose to keep behind it — a voice memo, a photo, a date. Tap a phone to the hem and it plays.

settings.title: Heavyweight, vintage-washed
settings.text: Oversized cut, garment-dyed and washed for a worn-in hand from the first day. Runs true to a size up.

settings.name: Essential
settings.description: The tee, the print, the chip — set to a photo of your choosing.
settings.features: Oversized heavyweight tee|Eye-print back graphic|NFC hem, linked to one photo

settings.name: Memory
settings.description: Everything in Essential, with the chip linked to a full memory — voice, video, or a place.
settings.features: Everything in Essential|NFC linked to voice or video|Numbered, verified print

settings.name: Signature
settings.description: Your own eyes on the back — a private commission, printed once, for you alone.
settings.features: Everything in Memory|Custom back print from your photo|Boxed with a printed certificate

settings.intro: An oversized tee carrying a real pair of eyes on the back — a memory printed, not drawn. Tap the hem's NFC chip and the moment plays back.
settings.split_note: Every shirt is numbered against its NFC chip at print — scan it and you're looking at the same file we printed, not a knockoff. When the drop sells out, that number closes.
settings.quote: I scanned the hem before I even tried it on. It played the voicemail I almost deleted.
settings.close_hint: Drop closes when the count hits zero.
